job_details.title: CI/CD Workflow Engineer
job_details.description: We are seeking a skilled CI/CD Workflow Engineer to join our team at ArenaF. The ideal candidate will have experience in managing continuous integration and continuous deployment workflows, ensuring efficient software delivery processes.
responsibilities: Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for various projects.
Collaborate with development teams to integrate automated testing.
Monitor and optimize CI/CD processes for performance and reliability.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to build and deployment.
Maintain documentation for CI/CD workflows and processes.
Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in CI/CD.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.
3-5 years of experience in CI/CD management.
Proficiency in tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI.
Experience with containerization technologies like Docker.
Strong understanding of version control systems, particularly Git.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
